property_summary: For any successfully filled short order, the position expiration must be recorded under the counterparty's short position id uint256(hashOppositeOrder(order)) equal to block.timestamp + duration; the mutant instead writes it under uint256(hashOrder(order)), leaving the short position id's expiration at zero.
change_summary: Always store the expiration under uint256(orderHash) instead of conditionally choosing positionId for short orders.
